facts.fact: Decree 2015-79 of 4 February 2015, issued under law 2013-450, requires prior authorisation from the telecoms regulator ARTCI for transferring personal data to a third country that gives equal or higher protection, and sets sanctions for non-compliance (articles 6 and 8).

Decree 2015-79 (article 7) sets the procedure for applying to ARTCI to transfer personal data to third countries: a Ivorian-law legal entity files a dossier giving the data, purpose, safeguards, host country and its legal framework, with ARTCI deciding within one month (article 4); the decree is hosted on ARTCI's site.
